decisions.decision: Run the critic in rounds rather than waiting for the whole build. Round 1 starts now: spawn the critic subagent with model fable (never Codex) on workshop-plan/REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md and the T-454 skeleton (brief, setup for the four assistants, api.mjs routing, logging). Also check banned vendors (approved-vendor-stack), the Backlinko voice, no dashes and no literal cohort dates. Log every finding in this task's log with an ID. Close this task only when the last round has no open findings and every finding has a fix commit.
